current_repetitions.heading: How to read LevelsRx pricing without inventing a total
current_repetitions.text: The captured price evidence for LevelsRx is: “From $150 per month for compounded semaglutide or oral compounded semaglutide; compounded tirzepatide starts at $240 per month” This review does not convert that wording into a recurring estimate when frequency, supply duration, inclusions, dose rules, or later-period pricing are absent. It also does not assume that consultation, laboratory work, supplies, shipping, membership, taxes, or follow-up are included. Each of those items is a separate verification question because combining them without direct evidence would create a price claim the source did not make.

current_repetitions.heading: Pricing breakdown
current_repetitions.text: LevelsRx publishes starting prices of $150 per month for compounded semaglutide, $240 per month for compounded tirzepatide, and $150 per month for oral compounded semaglutide. It states that virtual clinician consultations, prescription management, coaching, and lab charges are included without separate membership costs.
